notes.title: Monster Loves You Too! ❤️ Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]The Sequel Has Arrived![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149000/Monster_Loves_You_Too/

[h1]Begin Life as a Tiny Morsel[/h1]
You're born with FLESH, BRAIN, and GUTS. Grow arms, legs, and teeth. If you survive, you'll get to scavenge for the scraps that larger, meaner Monsters leave behind. Yippee!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4591481/1d4caa4d809ea5173f39e0ae917873acd03534fe.gif[/img]‎ ‎

[h1]Survive using FLESH, BRAIN, and GUTS.[/h1]
Use these three resources to overcome your Monstrous, impulsive tendencies. Spend them wisely, though, as they only replenish when you rest or feast. ‎ ‎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4591481/df436450af5ce5672d20659579239481dfb92aeb.gif[/img]

[h1]Make Choices![/h1]
The towering, 300-toothed Grattrag scours the ravine below for your friends. Do you fight or hide?
Join a gang or form your own?
[list]
[*] Eat your friend's arm? (Context: it looks very tasty, and you're famished.)
[*] Shun the scary loser to look cool... or comfort them and become a "loser" yourself?
[*] Let Gorry know that a rocket sled would not, in fact, be possible to create? (He'll be heartbroken!)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4591481/6b055cb2b15032060d62d4379aab86998cda3bce.gif[/img]

[h1]Visit the Fantastic Land of Monsters![/h1]
Built beneath ancient Human ruins, Asch is your home city, where you'll scavenge and hide among the alleys to survive. The Sharps are where wild Adolescents live free from the shackles of Monstrous society. Join a gang, or form your own. Visit Trade Hill, where shady Monsters meet to exchange precious, deadly Human artifacts.

If you liked the original, you'll love the sequel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149000/Monster_Loves_You_Too/

notes.title: Monster Loves You Too! Coming to Steam December 2022
notes.content:
[h1]YOU ARE BORN[/h1]
You are born in the city of Asch and find food, forge friendships, and fend off bigger monsters, all while resisting your own monstrous urges to cheat, steal, kill, and lie at every turn.

[previewyoutube=1z2x472vQ_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]YOUR INSTINCTS BIND YOU[/h1]
You emerge from a gooey vat, starving, naked, and alone. You wander the back streets of Asch, the monster metropolis, struggling to survive. Like your fellow monsters, you're plagued by vicious instincts. And it's comfortable to give into those instincts—your GREED stat makes it easier to hoard valuables than to share; your MALICE makes it compelling to attack the weak just for the thrill; and your DOCILITY forces you to lie around when you could be working.

[h1]BRAINS, GUTS, AND FLESH HELP YOU[/h1]
But you represent an unexpected branch in monster evolution. You have reserves of BRAINS, GUTS, and FLESH, which you can expend to overcome your base instincts. Maybe you'll use your BRAINS to persuade a group of warring orphans to band together. Or you'll spend some GUTS points to boldly challenge a dangerous wolverine. Marshall your reserves carefully, though, because if these precious resources run dry, you won't be able to resist the urge to tear a friend's arm off when you're hungry.

[h1]LIVE THE LIFE OF A MONSTER[/h1]
Grow up, grow old, and maybe even grow wise. Make friends, allies, and enemies. Break out of the slums, assemble your own gang, explore the wilderness, and unravel the political intrigue keeping monsterkind from clawing out of the pit of brutality. Monster Loves You Too! is the story of your life told over months, years, and the next century.

[h1]WISHLIST NOW![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149000/Monster_Loves_You_Too

notes.title: T-Minus 30 Launches!
notes.content:
[h1]Build a city, assemble a space fleet, and flee the Earth, all in 30 minutes.[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oBPdjvK7dyk
In T-Minus 30, you explore a post-apocalyptic environment and scavenge its resources to build enough rockets to save a small pocket of humanity.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32967242/209e3a6f7384cfdde60a9d771e2e68251ba19c0c.jpg[/img]

You start with a tiny settlement, where you till, irrigate, and farm the land to feed your people. As you expand, you exploit natural resources to build homes and roadways. You seek remnants of ancient civilization, mining ancient skyscrapers for their plastics and scavenging metal from the husks of automobiles you find in long-abandoned junkyards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32967242/89794b3d29b941596d4e6cfafee123be3e1ccf98.jpg[/img]

With those resources, you can either go high tech, building up solar farms and hydroponics labs to stock sleek generational ships that each rescue thousands of evacuees, or stay low-tech, brute-forcing your population off the Earth by building massive numbers of 1960s era rocketry.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32967242/b3790a17b308b63ec7c134ee9c1f162d35e0a1b3.jpg[/img]

After 30 minutes, the end comes, and you take off. You can't save everyone, but with you, there's hope for the future of humanity.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371750/TMinus_30/

notes.title: Monsters still Love You in 2017!
notes.content:
We've put a [i]monsterous[/i] amount of work into our latest update! We could scare you upright with all the [i]terrifying[/i] details of [b]complete engine replacement[/b] and dazzle you with the [i]romantic[/i] mystery of [b]bug-hunting[/b], but you probably just want the straight facts. You know, about the [i]lovely[/i] stuff that you, Friend of Monsters, can enjoy.

[list]
[*] Full gamepad and steam streaming support. You can now sit on your couch comfortably and scroll through the game without mouse or keyboard! Fun for the whole family (or house parties?!)
[*] Full touchscreen support while we're at it. We hear those tablet computers are a hot thing in those human cities!
[*] Full native Linux support! Maybe we will make a joke about a penguin in a tuxdeo here... No? Too forced?
[*] Thanks to the completely new engine on the back-end, your monsterly adventures will be running faster, smoother, and with at least [i]three[/i] more fidelities than were ever previously possible!
[/list]

Note: This new version will unfortunately dissolve your last saved adventure into the goo pits for future monster generations. If you really want to finish off that one last quest, you can revert to the "Classic" edition in Steam's properties menu (under the betas tab).
